Kuvitus: lattialla rata, jolla leluauto: Illustration: a track on the floor along which a toy car runs beside a tape measure. A group stands on each side of the track, and each group has its own stopwatch; the hands of the watches have stopped at different places.
Kaavakuva kokeen asetelmasta: leluauto a: Diagram of the experimental set-up: a toy car runs along a level track on a table from a start line to a finish line. Beside the track is a distance scale in metres, and the gap between the start line and the finish line is the independent variable, the distance s. A hand stopwatch measures the time t, which is the dependent variable. The car, the surface and the batteries are kept constant. The scale is accurate: 150 units in the picture correspond to one metre.
Kuvaaja suhteellisesta epävarmuudesta aj: Graph of relative uncertainty as a function of time when the uncertainty of the time is 0.2 s: at a time of 1 s the uncertainty is 20 %, at 4 s it is 5.0 %, and at 10 s it is 2.0 %. The green region shows measurements whose uncertainty is at most 5.0 %: they require a time of at least 4 s. The graph is drawn to scale.
